title: Fluted Crystal
author: Yi Shen
description: Original crystal still life by Yi Shen.
changes: Repacked as a single GLB; textures limited to 1024px; geometry compressed/quantized with gltf-transform Meshopt without simplification; PNG textures compressed with lossless WebP; default camera embedded; preview rendered with MuTracer and denoised with OIDN standard. Original materials, cameras and lighting retained without intensity changes.
